name: Scrunch AI
tagline: Generative engine optimization for AI search visibility.
description: Scrunch AI is an enterprise platform for monitoring and improving how brands show up in AI search and chat answers. It tracks citations and share-of-voice across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot, benchmarks against competitors by prompt, and flags crawl errors that keep pages out of AI answers. Its Agent Experience Platform serves AI-optimized versions of web pages so models and agents can read and cite them more reliably.
insight: Raised a $15M Series A in 2025 led by Decibel — about $19M total — with angels incl. Webflow's Bryant Chou and Clara Shih.

modelSupport.notes: Monitors brand visibility across multiple AI search engines.

edge: Beyond tracking AI-search mentions, its Agent Experience Platform serves AI-optimized page versions to boost how often models actually cite your site.
cons: Free access limited to a 7-day trial
